resources.string: Could not authenticate with the provider. Check the API key for the selected provider or sign in to the CLI again, then test the connection.
No connection to the provider. Check the network and the address.
The provider temporarily limited request frequency. Wait and test the connection again.
The engine is unavailable on this device. Check that it is installed and enabled, then restart the engine.
Access to this operation or model was denied. Check permissions and your subscription, or choose an available model. If the account is restricted, contact the provider to restore access.
The engine rejected the request. Check the connection method and model; for a custom server, also check the base URL and API path.
Credentials for this connection are unavailable on this device. Add the connection again with an API key or sign in to the CLI.
The connection credentials changed or do not match the engine. Check the provider and authentication method, then connect it again.
The provider quota is exhausted. Check your subscription and remaining allowance in the provider account, or choose another connection.
Choose the engine that will run your sessions.
No engines are available in this build.
The key is kept in the protected storage of your profile.
Development build: keys are saved locally without system protection, separately from release keys.
You may enter the full API base URL including its path, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.
The address is fixed for this provider.

The engine runs on the runtime that the %1$s app installs and updates, with its shared settings and history. This switches the engine\'s runtime for all its connections and replaces a custom executable. The app must be installed. Heartbeat never reads the app\'s own sign-in: if the CLI is not signed in yet, connecting opens the sign-in page in your browser.
Uses the sign-in of the engine\'s own CLI. If there is none yet, connecting opens the sign-in page in your browser. Heartbeat never reads, copies or refreshes its tokens.
The endpoint needs no credentials, for example a local model server.
Plain HTTP is allowed only for localhost; use https:// for other servers
Choose the models offered through this connection.
Engine × connection × model: choose what model pickers offer.
Select a connection to manage its models.
Delete “%1$s”? Current requests will be interrupted, and the connection and model choice removed. Chat history will be kept. A stored key is deleted when nothing else uses it.
Switching on, installation, updates, sign-in and launch settings
The engine is off. Switch it on in its control panel to add connections.
Cached list. Sync to refresh it.
Models have not been synced yet.
Could not download engine components. Check your connection and retry the operation.
Could not save engine components. Check free disk space and retry the operation.
Engine components could not be verified. Retry the operation to download them again.
Engine components are unavailable. Retry the operation.
